name: node
title: Board node
description: Anything the agent draws on the board, as one generic element whatever its type (D-015). Numbered nodes are items: they show the review buttons their type offers (NODE_TYPES) and reflect the person's response.

files.core: node-core.ts (nodeState, nodeLabel, offers, isPressed; no DOM)
files.template: node-template.ts (nodeTemplate: the only place the markup is built)
files.icons: node-icons.ts (KIND_ICON per kind, ACTION_ICON per action, svgIcon)
files.behaviour: node-note-tip.ts (bindNoteTip: a cut note's full-text tip, on the shared hover tip packages/ui/src/tip/hover-tip.ts bindHoverTip; browser only)
files.styles: node.css (scoped by the tag; tokens only); tip/tip.css (the shared hover tip's box)

parts.vb-node-num: tab in a gap on the top border, left: the item number (items only)
parts.vb-node-kind: tab in a gap on the top border, centred: the kind, with grip dots; the drag handle, the one place a card is moved from (3_FE_01)
parts.vb-node-pin: tab on the top border, right: shown when the person moved the node
parts.vb-size: nodeSize flag only (D-030): the size control in the top-right border gap; a glyph (vb-size-trig, the person's pick as "◆ S" in vb-size-shown) that lifts an S / M / L / Auto pill (vb-size-menu, buttons vb-size-opt with data-size-pick) on hover or keyboard focus; data-open forces it open for gallery samples
parts.vb-node-content: title (vb-node-title), body (div.vb-node-body, Markdown through renderMarkdown), tags as chips (vb-node-tags), note block
parts.vb-note-pin: items only (2e_FE_01): the note pin, a numbered button hanging off the top-right corner with the latest note's number; data-note is its seq, data-sent once sent, aria-expanded while its bubble is open; hidden with no notes
parts.vb-node-notes: the "Your note" block: 'N notes' (vb-node-notes-count) over several, then each note latest first (vb-node-note, data-note = its seq, data-sent once sent) with who (vb-node-note-who, 'Your note 2 · Sent') over the text (vb-node-note-text, Markdown, cut at three lines: the line clamp plus a three-line height cap, so a list or code block is cut too); each note is a tab stop (tabindex 0; Enter opens it) and holds its full text again as a tip (vb-note-tip, aria-hidden, Markdown); hidden with no notes
parts.vb-node-foot: items only: kind icon (vb-node-kico), divider (vb-node-sep), state word (vb-node-status), quick actions (vb-node-actions)

attributes.data-id: the node id; the page finds a node with closest('vb-node')
attributes.data-kind: one of KINDS; see NODE_TYPES in packages/format/src/node-types.ts. Colour comes from --kind, which render() sets to var(--vb-kind-<kind>)
attributes.data-status: open | acknowledged | dropped | commented | context | later (set by update)
attributes.data-pinned: present when the person moved it (set by update)
attributes.data-selected: present while the person has it selected (3_FE_01; view state the page passes to nodeState, set by update): mockup 05's look, 1.5px in the card's own colour with a soft glow
attributes.data-emphasis: present when the agent marked the node as emphasised (set by render)
attributes.data-size: nodeSize flag only: s | m | l, the tier from sizeTier (packages/layout), which picks the width token; set by update before the page measures
attributes.data-size-picked: nodeSize flag only: present when the person picked the size (set by update)
attributes.aria-label: number, kind, title and status (nodeLabel, set by update), then ', selected' while selected
attributes.data-noted: present when the item has a note (set by update)
attributes.data-bubble: present while its note bubble is open, so the card draws over its neighbours (set by the page)
attributes.data-tip-open: on a note (vb-node-note), while its full-text tip is open beside the card, and the card is drawn above its neighbours: the pointer on the note or the tip, or focus on the note, while the note is cut (set by the note-tip behaviour; notePreview flag, which the page shows as data-note-preview on its world); Esc dismisses it, a click opens the bubble instead
attributes.--card-surface, --card-surface-sunken, -: wireLayers flag only (D-032): fills the page sets on the world (board.css, [data-wire-layers]) as --vb-card-fill of the card, topic and note surface over transparent, so a connector drawn behind a card shows through. node.css reads them with the solid token as fallback (--surface; a note's background), so with the flag off the colours are exactly as before
attributes.data-zoom: on the stage, not the node: 'far' below FAR_K, only with the hideControlsZoomedOut flag (off, tracker N13), hides the quick actions and the size control (keeping their space); the keyboard shortcuts still work

methods.render(n: ViewNode, opts?: { sizeControl: once per view version: data-*, role, tabindex, --kind, innerHTML = nodeTemplate(n, opts)
methods.update(st: NodeState): on every state change: attributes and text only (data-status, data-pinned, data-selected, aria-label, aria-pressed, status word, note who, and the note text as Markdown when it changed; with st.size, data-size, data-size-picked and the size control's label, letter and pressed choice), so focus survives

events: data-act button click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> action layer
data-size-pick button click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the size act (nodeSize flag)

hover or keyboard focus on a cut note opens its tip (notePreview flag); the pointer may cross onto the tip, which scrolls past 240px and draws no actions; Esc dismisses it; a press in the tip opens nothing
a click on the note pin or a note ([data-note]) bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the note bubble
whenToUse: Anything the agent draws that the person should read or respond to.
whenNotToUse: Region headings and lane labels; those belong to the region pattern.
accessibility: Focusable list item with a label naming number, kind, title and status; a selected card's label ends ', selected' (a list item takes no aria-selected), and the page announces the count in a polite live region. Selection is not focus: the focus ring still draws on a selected card. Buttons are real buttons with labels and aria-pressed. Text: the content (title, body, tags, notes, Markdown code blocks) is selectable; the tabs, the size control, the pin and the footer are not. Keyboard: Space adds the focused card to the selection or takes it out; A X C M L O respond (C and M open the note bubble, editing the note not yet sent if there is one; the note pin is a tab stop labelled 'Note 1 on item 4. Edit it'), Alt+Arrows move, R resets the position, J K move between items. A note is a tab stop: focus shows its full text in the tip (aria-hidden, since the note itself is already read in full), Enter opens it in the note bubble; Esc closes the tip without moving focus. Size control: the glyph is one tab stop labelled 'Card size: S, automatic. Change size' (or 'your pick'); focusing it opens the pill, whose four buttons follow in the tab order with aria-pressed; Esc closes it and returns focus to the card.
